body: Hey! Are we still on for the design review this afternoon? I have the new prototypes ready to share.
Yes, definitely. Let's aim for 2pm — I want to see how you handled the new navigation structure.
Perfect. I moved the sidebar to a fixed 280px and gave the active item the yellow bar. It reads much calmer.
Let me know when you have time for a quick call.
The atrium rendering is up on the feed if you want to take a look.
Saw it — the skylights do all the work. Beautiful.
Digest batching is live. Want me to write the changelog entry or will you?
Contrast audit is done. Two chips failed at AA and I've fixed both — details in the doc.
